description: MainActivity.java defines the main activity of an Android application that initializes UI components, manages fragments, and sets up logging functionalities.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity class that extends SampleActivityBase to create the primary user interface for the app, manages fragment transactions, and configures logging.

methods.description: Inflates the options menu for the activity.
